text_block_list.text: One day, while walking around the school—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Don't try to stop me, Boss. There's 
something I gotta do.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It seems I cannot stop you... And by the 
way, it's 'Princess', not 'Big Sis'...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Ngh!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, Trainer, huh? Nah, it's nothing to 
worry about.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm just taking off the mental shackles to 
take care of some "errands"... I guess you 
could say.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Vodka-san mentioned not wanting to attend 
remedial classes, so I am helping lift her 
spirits!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami-senpaaaai! Why would you say that 
out loud!?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I-It can't be helped, okay!? The test 
covered way too much material this time!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Cramming the night before just didn't cut 
it... Look, I hate taking lame makeup 
classes just as much as anyone!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Still, it's not like I can just slack 
off. So I was walking around trying to 
figure out some way to get pumped up, 
and—"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"I called out to you thinking that perhaps 
I could be of some assistance!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
After hearing what you had to say, I am 
absolutely certain! Remedial classes—they 
must be treated as our "fated nemesis"!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
The tragic knight Vodka, who casts aside 
her beloved princess—me— to go defeat her 
fated nemesis...! Well? Doesn't that get 
you hyped up!?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ah, buzzkill. Now I'm totally sobered up. 
Gotta hit reset on this...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Oh right, since you're here, you might as 
well join us, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what a wonderful suggestion! In that 
case, Trainer-san's role will be—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Isn't it obvious! Naturally—

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
They're enemy commanders blocking the path 
to remedial lessons!! More like rival 
knights fighting over the princess, aren't 
they!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Huh, are you serious, Senpai!? In this 
case, it's definitely the enemy 
executive~!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"However, in the manga I know, a love 
triangle with a rival knight is the 
standard trope!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Guh... In that case, we'll just have to 
let Trainer pick whichever one they like 
best!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Which one do you want to do!?
choice_data_list: Rival knights vying for the princess

An enemy executive blocking the way to 
supplementary classes.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Eeeeh, are you serious!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, Vodka-san, Trainer-san... Which one 
of you should I choose?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Wait, you're already in?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, if Senpai says so, I've got no 
choice! —Traineeerrr!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I won't let anyone take Kawakami-senpai 
away. I decided I'd protect her that 
day...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It's been years since my pal Sam went 
missing. I took in Sam's older sister, 
Kawakami-senpai, determined to make 
something of ourselves in this rotten 
city—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Wait, cut, cuuuuut!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Huh, the good part starts now! How Sam and 
I first met in the dump...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Who on earth is Sam!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Besides, Vodka-san, you're supposed to be 
a knight! Why are you opening like a 
delinquent manga?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Well, I just thought this looked 
cooler... Love triangles are super 
embarrassing anyway..."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, absolutely not! A knight is, you 
see, a synonym for a prince!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I absolutely will not yield on this point! 
Allow me to instruct you from scratch!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
......M-Man, I kinda feel like goin' to 
remedial class now~.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
No, I will not let you leave just yet! 
First, let me explain what a knight truly 
is—

...Kawakami Princess's passionate coaching 
continued, until Vodka finally let out a 
scream and fled toward the classroom.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hah, that's what I'm talkin' about!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
—Out of the way, Trainer! I won't let 
*anyone* block my path...!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Eeeehk!? You're not blocking them at all!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
That was quite an abrupt conclusion, 
wasn't it...?
choice_data_list:
If you finish it up quickly, I'll treat 
you to something.

If you finish up quickly, I'll treat you 
to something!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Wait, for real?! Even the school store's 
"Bun-Is-Also-A-Patty! All-Meat Burger" is 
fine!?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Aw, yeah! I've got front-row seats!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Just you wait, Trainer. I'll finish this 
up in no time!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you so much too, 
Kawakami-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my... How vivid. As expected, you two 
truly understand one another, don't you?

I think Vodka's just being 
straightforward, but... anyway, I decided 
to finish prepping the "Meat-Loaded 
Burger" first.
